data.one_liner: Access the advertising ID on iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple API to retrieve the advertising ID and check if limit ad tracking is enabled. It wraps the native platform services for iOS and Android.
use_when: You need the advertising ID for analytics or ad targeting.
You want to respect the user’s limit ad tracking setting.
avoid_when: You are building a web or desktop app, as the plugin only supports mobile.
strengths: Simple API, no build_runner or code generation required.
Keeps native dependencies up to date with recent Android and iOS changes.
weaknesses: No support for web or desktop.
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and run flutter pub get. No additional native configuration is required beyond the plugin’s defaults.
